title: Hard Hat Economics: What’s reshaping nonresidential construction?
summary: Despite a historic boom in data center construction, nonresidential spending has declined since its April 2025 peak. In this blog, Dr. Anirnban Basu discusses the main drivers behind this decline and what they could mean for the broader construction industry.
